description: This file defines the CoreFixtureService class used for managing test fixtures in the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for retrieving services, saving fixture data, and checking the readiness of fixtures. It references various fixture classes and interacts with the database and configuration settings.

classes.name: CoreFixtureService
classes.description: A service class for managing test fixture data, including saving fixture data to the database and verifying fixture readiness.

methods.name: getTextHelperService
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of TextHelperService, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Provides access to the Doctrine EntityManager.

methods.name: saveToFixtures
methods.description: Iterates through registered fixtures and loads their data into the database, with a safety check on the database connection.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Checks whether all fixture files are present in the fixtures directory to determine if the setup is ready.
